scenarios.title: À la boulangerie
scenarios.situation: You're buying bread and pastries for a small party.
scenarios.goal: Buy what you need and ask the price.

scenarios.title: Au café
scenarios.situation: You meet a new neighbour at a café.
scenarios.goal: Introduce yourself and ask about them.

scenarios.title: Demander son chemin
scenarios.situation: You're lost downtown and need the metro.
scenarios.goal: Find out how to get to the metro.

scenarios.title: Chez le médecin
scenarios.situation: You've had a sore throat for three days.
scenarios.goal: Explain your symptoms and understand the advice.

scenarios.title: Appeler un propriétaire
scenarios.situation: You call about an apartment for rent.
scenarios.goal: Ask about the rent, what's included and when you can visit.

scenarios.title: Raconter son week-end
scenarios.situation: A colleague asks about your weekend on Monday.
scenarios.goal: Tell what you did and ask about theirs.

scenarios.title: À la banque
scenarios.situation: You want to open an account.
scenarios.goal: Open an account and ask about fees.

scenarios.title: Un colis perdu
scenarios.goal: Explain the problem and get a refund or replacement.

scenarios.title: Entretien d'embauche
scenarios.situation: You're interviewing for an office job in Montréal.
scenarios.goal: Present your experience and ask about the job.

scenarios.title: Un voisin bruyant
scenarios.situation: Your neighbour's music keeps you up at night.

scenarios.title: S'inscrire à un cours
scenarios.situation: You want to sign up for an evening French course.
scenarios.goal: Find out the schedule, price and level test.

scenarios.title: Le télétravail
scenarios.situation: Your manager wants everyone back at the office.
scenarios.goal: Argue for keeping two days of remote work.

scenarios.title: Ville ou campagne
scenarios.situation: A friend is thinking of leaving the city.
scenarios.goal: Discuss the pros and cons and give your view.

scenarios.title: Interdire les voitures au centre-ville
scenarios.situation: A local radio debate on car-free downtowns.
scenarios.goal: Take a position and defend it with examples.

scenarios.title: Les écrans et les enfants
scenarios.situation: A parents' meeting at school about screen time.
scenarios.goal: Compare views and suggest a compromise.
